crossRefs.note: They sent messengers to the inhabitants of Kiriath Jearim, saying, “The Philistines have brought back Yahweh’s ark.…
The men of Kiriath Jearim came and took Yahweh’s ark, and brought it into Abinadab’s house on the hill, and consecrated…
David arose, and went with all the people who were with him, from Baale Judah, to bring up from there God’s ark, which…
They brought in Yahweh’s ark, and set it in its place, in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and…
